differentiators.title: Advanced X-Nav Technology
differentiators.description: One of the first periodontists in Idaho to utilize X-nav technology for highly precise and predictable dental implant placement.

differentiators.title: S.M.A.R.T Graft Certified
differentiators.description: Home to Idaho’s only S.M.A.R.T Graft trained periodontist, offering advanced bone and tissue regeneration techniques.

differentiators.title: Laser Surgery Pioneer
differentiators.description: The first periodontist in Idaho to be certified in LANAP and implemented Periolase technology as early as 2008.

differentiators.title: Comprehensive Specialist Care

treatmentJourney.title: Initial Consultation & 3D Imaging
treatmentJourney.description: Dr. Moulton performs a comprehensive evaluation, utilizing advanced technology like OraVu DeVa endoscopes and 3D scans to plan your care.

treatmentJourney.title: Foundation Preparation
treatmentJourney.description: If needed, we perform specialized bone grafting, such as the S.M.A.R.T Graft or root coverage, to ensure a healthy environment for your new teeth.

treatmentJourney.title: Precise Implant Placement
treatmentJourney.description: Using X-nav technology for unmatched precision, the titanium or ceramic implant is surgically placed into the jawbone.

treatmentJourney.title: Healing & Osseointegration
treatmentJourney.description: Over several months, the implant fuses naturally with your bone. We monitor your progress closely to ensure perfect healing and stability.

treatmentJourney.title: Digital Impressions & Abutment
treatmentJourney.description: Once healed, we use Tekscan-Digital bite analysis to ensure your future restoration will fit perfectly and function comfortably with your bite.

treatmentJourney.title: Final Restoration Delivery
treatmentJourney.description: Your permanent crown, bridge, or full arch is delivered, restoring your confidence and providing a lasting, beautiful smile.

benefits.title: Advanced Implant Tech

benefits.title: Minimally Invasive Care

benefits.title: Specialized Bone Grafting

benefits.title: Holistic Treatment Options

benefits.title: Patient Comfort & Sedation

benefits.title: Restore Your Confidence
benefits.description: Regain the ability to smile and eat with confidence through permanent, natural-looking tooth replacement solutions.

implantOptions.title: Single Tooth Implant
implantOptions.description: A natural-looking solution to replace a missing tooth that feels secure and prevents future bone loss in the jaw.

implantOptions.title: Full-Mouth Reconstruction
implantOptions.description: Extensive training in complete arch restoration to return full function and aesthetic beauty to your entire smile.

implantOptions.title: All-on-4 Treatment
implantOptions.description: A permanent, fixed solution for a full arch of teeth supported by as few as four dental implants for ultimate stability.

implantOptions.title: Ceramic Dental Implants
implantOptions.description: Holistic implant options for patients seeking metal-free alternatives for their tooth replacement journey.

faqItems.question: What are the benefits of dental implants over dentures?
faqItems.answer: Dental implants look natural and feel secure. Most importantly, they are one of the only ways to prevent bone loss after a tooth root has been extracted.

faqItems.question: Am I a candidate for implants if I have bone loss?
faqItems.answer: Yes, Dr. Moulton offers advanced S.M.A.R.T Grafting and growth factors to promote bone regeneration, creating a stable foundation for your implants.

faqItems.question: Can you fix a dental implant that is failing?
faqItems.answer: We specialize in implant complications, helping patients with loose or failing implants, infections, bleeding, and sinus issues to restore health.

faqItems.question: Do you offer ceramic or holistic implant options?
faqItems.answer: For patients seeking holistic care, we provide options for synthetic bone grafts and ceramic dental implants to align with your personal health goals.

faqItems.question: Is the dental implant procedure painful?
faqItems.answer: Your comfort is our priority. We utilize minimally invasive technologies like X-nav and offer sedation options for patients who feel nervous or anxious.

faqItems.question: How do I get started with a consultation?
faqItems.answer: You can request an appointment by calling (208) 522-6683 or using our online registration. We work closely with your referring dentist for seamless care.

doctor.name: Ethan Moulton
doctor.bio: Dr. Ethan Moulton is Idaho Falls' premier periodontist and dental implant specialist. Since 2008, he has been a pioneer in advanced dental technology, becoming the first periodontist in Idaho to implement Periolase and the first certified to provide LANAP treatment. He is notably Idaho’s only S.M.A.R.T Graft trained specialist and has led formal study clubs through SPEAR Education for over 10 years. Dr. Moulton and his team are dedicated to helping patients achieve improved oral health and restored confidence through compassionate, expert care.
